# Vendored Legacy code

- Upstream: https://github.com/iqui27/nuvio-native-legacy
- Pinned commit: `287694ce4a0bcfd987170617f8069ca8ca52a468` (2026-10-25)
- Licence: GPL-3.0 (upstream `LICENSE`; the upstream files carry no per-file headers)

Files under `src/` were copied from upstream `src/` at the pinned commit and
then trimmed by deleting code this app does not use: DTS, Dolby Vision, MKV,
subtitles, other TV platforms, the old app's settings and design. Code is kept
byte-identical where possible, comments stay in Portuguese, and our additions
are marked `// marigold:`.

`shim/` holds small stand-ins for upstream modules we do not take (settings,
translations, screensaver fade, logs).

`patches/` holds one diff per file against the pinned upstream, generated by
`tools/legacy-diff.sh`. To pull an upstream fix: read the upstream diff of a
file we carry, apply it by hand or with `git apply`, regenerate the patches,
and update the pinned commit above.

## Files

| File | Upstream role |
|---|---|
| `video.c`, `video.h`, `video_modo.c`, `video_escala.h`, `video_reconexao.h`, `video_seekretry.h` | webOS player over LS2 (`com.webos.media`), video plane attach |
| `lsregistro.c/.h`, `webosver.c/.h`, `app_id.h`, `mediaurl.h` | LS2 registration, webOS version, ids |
| `livestall.h` | live stall watchdog |
| `rede.c/.h`, `rede_pedido.inc`, `redeurl.c`, `negcache.h/.inc`, `addonurl.h` | HTTP over the TV's libcurl (dlopen) |
| `js.c/.h` | tolerant JSON reader |
| `dados.c/.h`, `espaco.inc` | data directory, atomic writes |
| `sdlcompat.h`, `gl_compat.h` | SDL 2.0.2 and GLES header compatibility |
| `entrada_texto.c/.h` | LG on-screen keyboard |
| `chsegura.c/.h`, `teclavoltar.h` | CH+ hold vs tap, Back detection |
| `ponteiro.c/.h` | Magic Remote pointer |
